events.title: Demo v0.8.3 Update: Visual Feedback & New Skills
events.summary: We have completely removed the Scandal events; we realized they didn't have a significant impact on the overall flow of the game.With the removal of scandals, the related skills have been updated. You can now "shelve" risky documents without altering any power balances.We also made optimizations to reduce the game's overall file size.

events.title: Demo v0.8.2 Update: International Relations & Faster Bureaucrats!
events.summary: Language Support Expanded: French and Russian localizations have been added to the game!Faster NPC Animations: Palace staff and visitors will now leave the room much faster after their business is done, speeding up the gameplay flow.UI Improvements: Fixed minor user interface bugs to ensure a smoother bureaucratic experience.

events.title: Demo v0.8.1 Update: Minor Palace Renovations!
events.summary: Consequence Animations Added: Small reaction animations will now play after certain critical choices, showing you how events unfold! (We've activated this as a pilot feature for a single event for now; you will see it in more scenes in the future).Skill Tree Fix: The issue where skill descriptions were not showing up in the skill tree has been resolved. Huge thanks to Mods HD for the feedback and reporting this issue!

events.title: The Demo is Now Live!
events.summary: Hello everyone!We are incredibly excited to announce that the demo is officially available to play right now!This is just the beginning, and we want to shape the final version of the game together with you. We would love to hear your thoughts, development suggestions, and any issues you might encounter.Join Our Discord Community! The best way to share your feedback is by joining our Discord server. You can join us here.
